defender.title: Nuskha (defending champion, v5) - paper methods -> runnable recipe with quorum receipts
defender.pitch: Turn any research paper's methods section into a numbered recipe a grad student can actually run: parameter extraction, missing-steps audit, environment provisioning in Modal sandboxes, execution with logged artifacts, figure reconciliation (does the remade figure match the published one), and a 2-of-3 quorum-signed Reproduction Receipt. v5 upgrades: gate chain of role-experts (MoRBE), mask-geometry reconciliation decimals (SAM), three-ladder consistency, cost-aware router (Glimmer/Spark-Open on Baseten for bulk grading). Stack: Wonder (1M ctx) reads the paper, Spark plans, Glimmer drafts sandbox code, Modal executes, Spark Open grades similarity. Push the Frontier. Has beaten 30,568 ideas across three rounds.
